content.title: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters

This is a self-hosted commerce stack designed for digital creators who cannot use Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad. It combines free tools like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. The result is a fully operational online store where customers can purchase digital products using 300+ cryptocurrencies. You own the infrastructure, control the data, and bypass platform restrictions. No subscriptions, no recurring fees—just a one-time deployment cost. This architecture is pressure-tested in environments like Zimbabwe, where financial isolation and currency collapse are realities, not hypotheticals.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The stack operates on a simple yet robust architecture. Your static site is hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, both free and globally distributed. Backend logic is handled by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which processes orders and triggers file delivery. Payments are verified via NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies and charges a flat 0.5% fee. Once payment is confirmed on-chain, a webhook fires, updating your order storage (Supabase or Google Sheets) and delivering the product via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. The entire process is automatic, secure, and doesn’t require you to hold any cryptocurrency yourself. Transaction fees are minimal—USDT on Tron costs under $0.10, and Solana averages fractions of a cent per transaction.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This stack is built for digital creators in regions where conventional payment platforms are inaccessible or unreliable. If you sell ebooks, courses, templates, or software and cannot use Stripe or PayPal, this infrastructure gives you a direct line to global customers. It’s also for creators who want to own their commerce stack outright, without depending on platforms that can shut them down or delay payouts. For example, Gumroad’s payout delays can disrupt cash flow, but with this setup, payments settle directly to your wallet within minutes. This isn’t a temporary fix—it’s a permanent shift to infrastructure sovereignty, designed for creators who value autonomy over convenience.
NOWPayments’ 0.5% fee is transparent and lower than traditional processors, ensuring more profit per sale.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The stack consists of five core components: hosting (GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages), backend logic (Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script), order storage (Supabase or Google Sheets), file delivery (Google Drive or Cloudflare R2), and payment processing (NOWPayments). Each component is chosen for its reliability, cost-effectiveness, and ease of integration. For instance, NOWPayments’ 0.5% fee structure is transparent and lower than many traditional processors. The webhook integration ensures instant product delivery the moment payment confirms on-chain. This modular design means you can swap components as needed—for example, using Solana for faster, cheaper transactions or Tron for stable USDT payments under $0.10 per transaction.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this stack, start by choosing your hosting and backend tools—GitHub Pages with Google Apps Script for simplicity, or Cloudflare Pages with Workers for scalability. Set up NOWPayments to handle crypto payments, selecting stablecoins like USDT on Tron or Solana for low fees. Configure webhooks to automate order processing and file delivery. Load your products into the system, test end-to-end, and launch. If you prefer guided deployment, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates, streamlining the process. Every component is documented, and the infrastructure is yours to own and modify after deployment. No platform lock-in, no recurring fees—just a sovereign commerce stack built for your needs.
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

To receive crypto payments for your digital products, integrate NOWPayments into your static site. Set up a payment page, select your preferred cryptocurrencies (e.g., USDT on Tron or Solana for low fees), and configure a webhook to automate product delivery. Once a customer pays, NOWPayments verifies the transaction on-chain and triggers the webhook, updating your order storage and delivering the product. This process is automatic, secure, and doesn’t require you to hold cryptocurrency. Compared to PayPal, USDT payments on Tron or Solana settle within minutes, with transaction fees under $0.10 or fractions of a cent, respectively.
USDT on Tron and Solana offer transaction fees under $0.10 and fractions of a cent, respectively, making them ideal for digital product sales.

If you’re looking to convert crypto to local currency in regions like Nigeria, Ghana, or Kenya, P2P exchanges like Binance or Patricia offer reliable options. For a complete, step-by-step guide to deploying this stack, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates, available for instant download at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. This kit provides everything you need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack, valued at $348 if purchased separately.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your hosting platform: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 2. Set up backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. 3. Configure NOWPayments for crypto payment processing, selecting USDT on Tron or Solana for low fees. 4. Integrate webhooks to automate order processing and file delivery. 5. Set up order storage with Supabase or Google Sheets. 6. Upload your digital products to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. 7. Test the entire stack end-to-end before launching. 8. Deploy your site and start accepting payments.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I convert Bitcoin to naira in Nigeria?

Use P2P exchanges like Binance or Patricia to convert Bitcoin to naira. These platforms connect you directly with buyers and sellers, offering competitive rates and fast settlements. Ensure you verify the counterparty’s reputation before proceeding.
What are the transaction fees for USDT on Tron?
USDT transactions on Tron cost under $0.10 per transaction, making it an affordable option for digital product sales. This low fee structure ensures profitability even for low-priced items.
How does NOWPayments’ 0.5% fee compare to traditional processors?

NOWPayments charges a flat 0.5% fee per transaction, significantly lower than traditional processors like Stripe or PayPal, which often charge 2.9% + $0.30. This makes it an economical choice for creators.
Can I use this stack if I don’t hold cryptocurrency?

Yes, the stack is designed to handle payments without requiring you to hold cryptocurrency. NOWPayments processes the transaction, converts it to your chosen currency, and settles it directly to your wallet.
How long does it take for USDT payments to arrive compared to PayPal?
USDT payments on Tron or Solana settle within minutes, compared to PayPal’s typical 2-5 business days. This faster settlement improves cash flow and customer satisfaction.
